sources.title: Applied Digital Corporation, Form 10-Q for the quarter ended August 31, 2026 (fiscal first quarter 2027), filed 7 October 2026
sources.summary: In its Data Center Hosting Business discussion the quarterly report says the segment provides energized infrastructure to crypto-mining customers in custom-designed data centers, and that as of 31 August 2026 the company's 106 MW facility in Jamestown, North Dakota and its 180 MW facility in Ellendale, North Dakota continued to operate at full capacity; the segment earned $37.8 million in the quarter. Its commitments note refers to the energy services agreement for the Jamestown, North Dakota co-hosting facility. Separately it reports the Polaris Forge 1 HPC buildings in Ellendale (first 100 MW building operating since the prior fiscal year; second building reaching 150 MW by the filing date) and the construction of Polaris Forge 3 and Delta Forge 1.
sources.date_semantics: The status observation for both hosting facilities is the report's explicit 'as of August 31, 2026' operating statement (period end), published in the 10-Q signed and filed on 7 October 2026 (IR filing index captured apld-sec-filings.html lists the 10-Q at 10/07/26). Operation is scoped to the two crypto-mining hosting facilities; it says nothing about the separate Polaris Forge HPC buildings' status beyond what is stated.

sources.title: Applied Digital Corporation, Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2026, filed 29 July 2026 (PDF rendition on the issuer's investor site)
sources.summary: The annual report says the company operates hosting sites in Jamestown, North Dakota (a 106 MW facility) and Ellendale, North Dakota (a 180 MW facility) for a single crypto-mining customer, both at full capacity as of 31 May 2026. Its debt notes state that APLD Hosting, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary, is the borrower of the Starion Term Loan secured by its interests in the master hosting and electric services agreements related to the Jamestown hosting facility; that APLD GPU-01, LLC's AI cloud computing services are serviced at the Jamestown hosting facility; and that APLD ELN-01 LLC is the borrower of the Starion Ellendale Loan. It names APLD ELN-02 LLC, APLD ELN-03 LLC and APLD ELN-02 C LLC as the landlords of the Polaris Forge 1 HPC buildings in Ellendale. Item 2 says the company owns its Polaris Forge and Delta Forge data centers and their land.
sources.date_semantics: Annual report signed and filed on 29 July 2026 (IR annual-reports index captured apld-annual-reports.html lists the 10-K at 07/29/26); used for entity-to-facility identity only, not as a status observation. The PDF is the issuer-hosted rendition of the filing whose HTML version is already Atlas evidence; its own bytes and URL are captured here.
